props.gloss_en: R' Yehuda: [over vegetables one says] 'Who creates kinds of herbs'
the halakha is not as R' Yehuda
the verse says 'Blessed is the Lord day by day' -- does one bless Him by day and not by night? rather it tells you: each and every day, give Him blessings fitting that day
so too here: each and every kind [of food], give Him blessings fitting that kind -- R' Yehuda's reason
